visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white crop top under a beige open shirt, sits on a couch in a brightly lit living room with a white brick wall background. She excitedly points to a black fitness tracker on her left wrist while looking directly at the camera. (2) A transition graphic appears on a light blue background with icons of a lightbulb and clouds, displaying text about the first feature. This is followed by a close-up of the fitness tracker's oval screen showing an animated otter and the time 18:53. (3) The woman returns to the frame, speaking animatedly and pointing to the device. A split-screen or cut-in shows her face in an extreme close-up with wide eyes, expressing surprise while holding the tracker module. A physical comparison follows, showing the Mi Band 10 next to the Mi Band 9 on a wooden table to highlight the symmetrical bezels. (4) Another graphic transition leads to the second feature. The woman holds up a white ceramic version of the tracker with a white strap, demonstrating its flexibility by bending it. Close-up shots show the smooth, reflective finish of the ceramic body on a table. (5) A digital scale is used to compare the weight of the black standard version versus the white ceramic version, showing the latter is heavier. The woman smiles and gestures, acknowledging the trade-off for beauty. (6) A third graphic transition introduces the final point. The woman continues her presentation, followed by a brief shot of her sleeping in a dimly lit bedroom wearing the tracker to illustrate its sleep monitoring. (7) In the final phase, the woman holds the tracker while a large text overlay lists prices for different models. She points downward towards the bottom of the screen, inviting viewers to leave comments.
